name: zfmv_action_image_constructor_with_screen_rect
description: zFMV_ActionImage::ConstructorWithScreenRect initializes a static-image FMV action, duplicates the image path, stores the adjust-surface flag, commits blit X/Y into the recovered global blit rect, inherits its current W/H fields, and returns this.
known_limits: The smoke verifies the constructor field/global contract. Current-session zfmv_action_constructors VC5SP3 compare for 0x463130 reports zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463130 validates the MSVC thiscall constructor shape: install the action-image vtable, clear next and image, duplicate the path through _strdup, store doAdjustSurfaces, write g_zFMV_ActionImage_BlitRect top/left from the constructor arguments, set forcePrimaryPostprocess to 1, copy the global rect into blitRect, and return self.

The native smoke verifies returned self, action-image vtable identity, next/image clearing, duplicated path contents, doAdjustSurfaces, forcePrimaryPostprocess, global left/top side effects, and blitRect values using constructor left/top plus preexisting global right/bottom.
